description: This file is a C source file implementing API wrapper functions and control logic for hostapd interactions within a Wi-Fi radio management system. It manages configuration, channel switching, interface activation/deactivation, and communication with hostapd instances via control interfaces.

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrlInterface_t * s_getFirstReadyIface(T_Radio * pRad)
methods.description: Retrieves the first ready WPA control interface associated with a radio.

methods.name: bool s_sendHostapdCommand(T_Radio * pR,char * cmd,const char * reason)
methods.description: Sends a command to hostapd via the first ready interface.

methods.name: swl_bit32_t wld_rad_calculateDisabledSubchannelsBitmap(T_Radio * pR,swl_chanspec_t * pChSpec)
methods.description: Calculates a bitmap of disabled subchannels based on the radio's configuration and channel specifications.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_action_rc_ne wld_rad_hostapd_setOperatingStandard(T_Radio * pRadio)
methods.description: Updates the operating standard in hostapd configuration, prompting reload with SIGHUP if changed.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne s_calculateSecChannelOffset(swl_bandwidth_e bandwidth,uint32_t freq,uint32_t center_freq,int * sec_channel_offset)
methods.description: Determines the secondary channel offset based on bandwidth and frequency parameters for channel switching.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne wld_rad_hostapd_switchChannel(T_Radio * pR)
methods.description: Performs channel switching by configuring hostapd with new frequency, bandwidth, and standard parameters.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne wld_rad_hostapd_reload(T_Radio * pR)
methods.description: Reloads hostapd configuration from memory via a control command.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne wld_rad_hostapd_reconfigure(T_Radio * pR)
methods.description: Reconfigures hostapd from file, executing commands for reload/update support detection.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_action_rc_ne wld_rad_hostapd_setChannel(T_Radio * pR)
methods.description: Sets main interface channel parameters in hostapd configuration.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_action_rc_ne wld_rad_hostapd_setMiscParams(T_Radio * pRad)
methods.description: Sets miscellaneous radio parameters in hostapd configuration.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne wld_rad_hostapd_enable(T_Radio * pR)
methods.description: Enables the main hostapd interface by sending an ENABLE command.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne wld_rad_hostapd_updateAllVapsConfigId(T_Radio * pRad)
methods.description: Updates the config ID for all VAPs in the hostapd configuration.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne wld_rad_hostapd_updateMaxNumStations(T_Radio * pRad)
methods.description: Updates the maximum number of stations for all active VAPs.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne wld_rad_hostapd_disable(T_Radio * pR)
methods.description: Disables the main hostapd interface by sending a DISABLE command.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne wld_rad_hostapd_addConf(T_Radio * pR)
methods.description: Adds radio and VAP configuration to hostapd.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne wld_rad_hostapd_removeConf(T_Radio * pR)
methods.description: Removes radio and VAP configuration from hostapd.

methods.name: swl_trl_e wld_rad_hostapd_getCfgParamSupp(T_Radio * pRad,const char * param)
methods.description: Checks support for specific parameter command in hostapd.

methods.name: T_AccessPoint * wld_rad_hostapd_getFirstConnectedVap(T_Radio * pRad)
methods.description: Returns the first connected VAP, if any, based on connection status.

methods.name: T_AccessPoint * wld_rad_hostapd_getSavedMainVap(T_Radio * pRad)
methods.description: Retrieves the main VAP (virtual access point) from saved configuration.

methods.name: T_AccessPoint * wld_rad_hostapd_getCfgMainVap(T_Radio * pRad)
methods.description: Determines the main VAP based on several configuration conditions.

methods.name: T_AccessPoint * wld_rad_hostapd_getRunMainVap(T_Radio * pRad)
methods.description: Gets the currently active main VAP based on interface status.

methods.name: bool wld_rad_hostapd_hasActiveApMld(T_Radio * pRad,uint32_t minNLinks)
methods.description: Checks if there are active Multi-Link Devices (MLD) in the radio.
